Creates, verifies, and removes genesis.bin for bootstrap configuration.

# Purpose
This file defines the `genesis` configure stage for a Firedancer node. It creates, verifies, and removes the `genesis.bin` file used to start a Solana cluster. The code loads required account keys for the identity, faucet, stake account, and vote account, then builds a genesis blob with `fd_genesis_create`. It also sets genesis options such as the creation time, faucet balance, stake amount, tick timing, slot timing, initial account funding, and warmup epochs.

The file also manages Proof of History settings and feature flags. It estimates `hashes_per_tick` when the value is set to `0`, uses sleep mode when the value is `1`, and otherwise uses the configured value. It disables all features, enables the cleaned-up feature set for the target cluster version, and then applies a fixed default feature table. The [`check`](<#check>) function reads an existing `genesis.bin`, decodes it, creates a new genesis blob from the current configuration, and compares the two in detail. It checks account lists, native instruction processors, rewards pools, PoH settings, fee settings, rent settings, inflation settings, epoch schedule values, and cluster type. The [`init`](<#init>) and [`fini`](<#fini>) functions create and remove the file, and the stage is exported through `fd_cfg_stage_genesis`.
